desc:
🚛 Welcome to Semi Truck Obby!

Think you have what it takes to handle a big rig? Put your driving skills to the test in this ultimate semi-truck obstacle course!

HOW TO PLAY
🛣️ Avoid the red zones, be careful on ice, and don’t fall off the track!
🎨 Unlock truck skins and horns as you unlock new stages!
🏆 Prestige to unlock exclusive skins and horns!
🥇 Climb the leaderboards and prove you’re one of the best drivers!

Controls:
• WASD - Move your truck
• R - Reset to last checkpoint
• H - Blast horn
